why: A free function with a declared `this` parameter takes its receiver as an explicit first operand; `f.call(o, a)` and `f.apply(o, [a])` on a same-file function are the call with that operand. scaled commutes the product: proved. viaCall passes o through apply instead of call: the same call, proved. viaApply builds a fresh receiver with k + 1: witnessed. tagOf and named untouched: proved.
